mateu
Hands-on workshop

Declare it once.
Run it everywhere.

Half a day of labs. You type, it runs: on the web, on Oracle Redwood, on your phone, in a desktop app, for an AI agent.

What Mateu is

A model-driven UI system

You declarea model of the UI — as code (Java, C#, Python) or as data (YAML)
→
One wirethe server answers /mateu/v3/sync: what is on the screen, never how to draw it
→
Every rendererVaadin · Oracle Redwood · the phone app · the desktop app · an AI agent over MCP

No frontend code for typical business apps. Served by a backend, or shipped as a static bundle with no backend at all.

How today works

You type. Everything runs.

  • Pick a track: Java, C# or Python — the shared labs are the same for all
  • Each lab: a guide, a start/ and a solution/ — generated from the starters
  • Fell behind? Open the next lab's start/: it is where you should be
  • Every lab ends with a ✅ checkpoint — something you can see working

Lab 01 · 35′

Your first app

  • Generate it with the New Project wizard (or open start/)
  • Run it: a shell, a home page, a whole Products CRUD
  • Add a field — it is a column, an input and a server-checked rule
  • Add a screen of your own: a Quote with a Calculate button

✅ Checkpoint — Quantity 3 × 10, discount 10 % → 27.00

Lab 02 · 30′

One UI, every renderer

  • Java: swap mateu-vaadin for mateu-redwood — same app, Oracle Redwood
  • C# / Python: point MATEU_UI at the other jar
  • Phone: scan a QR — museums.ec1.mateu.io opens natively
  • Desktop: mateu://add?u=museums.ec1.mateu.io

✅ Checkpoint — One public UI on your phone and in the desktop app

Lab 03 · 25′

Test it like a user

  • The harness opens a route like a renderer — no browser, no server
  • field(…).set · button(…).press · listing().rows
  • Break the Quote on purpose and watch the right test fail
  • Java mateu-test · C# Mateu.AspNetCore.Testing · Python mateu_ui.testing

✅ Checkpoint — Four UI tests green — and one red for the right reason

Lab 04 · 35′

UI as data

  • The same model as YAML under specs/ui — no code at all
  • mvn mateu-bundle:dev: live reload while you edit
  • The visual editor in IntelliJ or VS Code; a page over a live public API
  • mvn package → a folder for any CDN, no backend

✅ Checkpoint — Products + Planets served as static files

Lab 05 · 30′

AI agents over MCP

  • One setting: your app is an MCP server at /mateu/mcp
  • An agent lists, describes and operates your screens — same rules as a user
  • Connect AI → a pairing code → the agent pushes a screen it wrote
  • Validated before it is sent; untrusted when it is shown

✅ Checkpoint — Your agent ran calculate; its page opened over your app

Lab 06 · 30′

Sign-in

  • Keycloak in Docker: realm, client, ada (manager) and bob (clerk)
  • Mateu offers the sign-in; your framework validates the token
  • @EyesOnly(roles = "manager") — applied on the server, for every client
  • Tested with an identity, no Keycloak needed

✅ Checkpoint — ada sees Discount; bob does not; anonymous gets 401
